brief.claim: Of the 120 cells in a calcium-imaging field of view, those that respond to the tone are mostly genuine responders: at least 70% of them show a larger mean fluorescence after tone onset than before it.

data_keys.meaning: mean fluorescence (dF/F) in the 1 s before tone onset, per cell and trial
mean fluorescence (dF/F) in the 1 s after tone onset, per cell and trial
